name: SignNow
description: Get documents signed faster without switching between tools. The SignNow MCP server connects Claude directly to your SignNow account, letting you manage the entire eSignature workflow through conversation. Send signature requests, create documents from templates and pre-fill them, track invite statuses, and retrieve signed files — all by describing what you need in plain language. Whether you're handling contracts, agreements, or approvals, Claude handles the SignNow actions so you can focus on your work instead of chasing signatures.

_published_faq.name: How do I add SignNow to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add SignNow to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp-server.signnow.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the SignNow MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: SignNow lists 16 MCP tools, including list_all_templates, list_documents, send_invite, create_embedded_invite, create_embedded_sending, create_embedded_editor, create_from_template, send_invite_from_template, create_embedded_sending_from_template, create_embedded_editor_from_template, create_embedded_invite_from_template, and get_invite_status.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to SignNow?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to SignNow in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
SignNow requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
SignNow is developed by airSlate Inc. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
